from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its assigned cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as it appears")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action assigned to this document based on the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
